fieldData.acrm---key-feature-3-content:
Fasting times checked against your rule

Ask when the patient last ate and last drank on the morning of the case. An answer inside your group's cutoff holds the case and alerts the provider who will give the anesthetic.
fieldData.acrm---key-feature-5-content:
Past reactions and family history

Ask about the patient's own reactions to anesthesia and any blood relative's, like a fever in surgery. A yes reaches the anesthesiologist before surgery day, in the patient's words.
fieldData.awb---integration-feature-1:
One late breakfast holds a 9:00 case

Lumen Endoscopy Center's rule, set with its anesthesia group, is no solid food for 8 hours before sedation. Each morning check-in asks when the patient last ate. Greg Holloway types toast at 6:40 a.m. for his 9:00 a.m. colonoscopy. His case waits, and CRNA Joy Park sees the answer before anyone starts an IV.
fieldData.acrm---integration-feature-4:
Before the hernia repair, a call about his uncle

Maple Hill Hospital's pre-op clinic asks if any blood relative has had a problem with anesthesia, like a high fever. Paul Reyes checks yes: his uncle ran a high fever during an operation in 2019. Dr. Omar Haddad, the anesthesiologist, gets the answer and calls Paul 2 days before his hernia repair.

fieldData.afb---how-to-step-6-des: Connect the form to your scheduling system through its API. Fasting answers inside your cutoff hold the case on the schedule, and a yes on family history alerts the anesthesiologist by email or Slack before the day of surgery.

fieldData.awb---key-feature-1-content:
Skin notes on Wren's screen the night before

Thistle Skin Studio sends the intake link with every first-facial booking. Lena Cho answers the day she books, noting combination skin and a fragrance allergy. The evening before, esthetician Wren Ito gets an email with those answers for the 10:00 facial. They stay on Lena's profile for later visits.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { firstFacials: "I run Thistle Skin Studio. Build an esthetician intake form that goes out with every first-facial booking confirmation. Ask for skin type, the products the client uses morning and night, any allergies, and their top skin goal. The evening before the appointment, email the esthetician a card with that client's answers, and keep everything on the client's profile.", returningClients: "Build an intake form for returning clients at Birchwood Day Spa. Open it with last visit's answers already filled in, so the client only edits what changed, and mark each change on their record for the front desk. If the last full intake is more than 12 months old, open the form blank instead.", medSpaIntake: "My business is Calla Med Spa, and we use one intake form for every service. Add a health history section. If a client answers yes to any question there, put the booking on hold and send our nurse practitioner, Bea Marsh, a card with the record to review. Show the front desk which bookings are on hold.", videoConsults: "I'm a solo esthetician running Fern Mobile Facials. Build a consultation form for my free 15-minute video consults. Ask the client for three photos taken in daylight, one from the front and one from each side, and their top concern from a short list. Save the photos with the request so I can look at them before the call." };
fieldData.afb---prompt: Build an esthetician intake form that saves every response to a database I own.

awb---key-feature-1-image.alt: A first-facial intake at Thistle Skin Studio records combination skin and a fragrance allergy, and an email gives esthetician Wren Ito those answers for Lena Cho's 10:00 facial.

fieldData.acrm---key-feature-5-content:
Answers that reach a named person

Sends a Slack or email alert to the staff member who owns an answer, such as a latex allergy to whoever preps the exam room, with reminders until someone marks it seen.
fieldData.awb---integration-feature-2:
A blood thinner or an anesthesia problem alerts the nurse

Westgate Surgery Center asks patients to finish the history 5 days before the procedure. Hana Okafor, the pre-op nurse, hears about a blood thinner on the medication list or a past problem with anesthesia. Walter Brandt lists warfarin before his hernia repair. She gets an email and calls him that afternoon.

fieldData.afb---how-to-step-6-des: Pick the answers that cannot wait for the visit, and assign each to one named person instead of a shared inbox. Choose email or Slack for each, and name a second person to hear about it when the first is out.
fieldData.afb---prompt: Build a medical history form that saves every response to a database I own.

acrm---key-feature-3-image.alt: Walter Brandt's pre-op history, finished 5 days before his hernia repair, lists warfarin; the blood thinner rule sends pre-op nurse Hana Okafor an email.

fieldData.awb---integration-feature-2:
Allergies by table number, in the kitchen at 4 pm

Every booking at Kinto Ramen asks about the nine major food allergens, with a box for anything else. At 4 pm the kitchen channel in Slack gets tonight's flagged tables with their seat times. Table 6 at 6:00 tops the list with a sesame allergy.

fieldData.acrm---key-feature-4-content:
A list of who has not signed yet

Pick the hour, and the app emails your pre-op nurse every case on the next day's schedule that still has no signature. Each line on that list carries the patient's phone number.
fieldData.awb---key-feature-1-content:
No signature yet from 3 of Thursday's 22 patients

Marrowfield Surgery Center emails the consent link to every patient booked for surgery. Thursday has 22 cases on the schedule. At 2:00 PM on Wednesday, 19 of 22 are signed, and pre-op nurse Odette Rainsford gets an email listing the 3 patients who have not signed, each with a phone number to call.
